requirements.text: This global technical regulation (gtr) shall apply to the frontal surfaces of power driven vehicles of category 1-1 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg; and of category 1-2 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg but not exceeding 4,500 kg; and of category 2 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg but not exceeding 4,500 kg. 2 However, power driven vehicles of category 1-2 and category 2, where the distance, measured longitudinally on a horizontal plane, between the transverse centre line of the front axle and the R-point of the driver's seat is less than 1,100 mm, are exempt from the requirements of this regulation.
requirements.quote: This global technical regulation (gtr) shall apply to the frontal surfaces of power driven vehicles of category 1-1 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg; and of category 1-2 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg but not exceeding 4,500 kg; and of category 2 with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 500 kg but not exceeding 4,500 kg. 2 However, power driven vehicles of category 1-2 and category 2, where the distance, measured longitudinally on a horizontal plane, between the transverse centre line of the front axle and the R-point of the driver's seat is less than 1,100 mm, are exempt from the requirements of this regulation.

requirements.quote: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).
requirements.quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).

requirements.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).
requirements.quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).

requirements.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above.

requirements.text: If the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, the component or STU shall show no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., for production to be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances.

requirements.text: When front fog lamps of Class F3 have asymmetric light distribution and must not be indiscriminately mounted on either side of the vehicle, the front fog lamps shall bear an arrow pointing to the outside of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Front fog lamps of Class F3 having asymmetric light distribution and which must not be indiscriminately mounted on either side of the vehicle, shall bear an arrow pointing to the outside of the vehicle;

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear a marking indicating the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), a marking on the light source module(s) indicating: (a) The trade name or mark of the applicant;

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear a marking indicating the specific identification code of the module.
requirements.quote: (b) The specific identification code of the module.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), the specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the markings as described in paragraphs 3.3.2.1. (without the circle) and 3.3.2.2. and, in case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.quote: This specific identification code shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the markings as described in paragraphs 3.3.2.1. (without the circle) and 3.3.2.2. and, in case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters.

requirements.text: The specific identification code of the module shall be shown in the drawings mentioned in paragraph 3.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: This identification code shall be shown in the drawings mentioned in paragraph 3.1.2.1.

requirements.text: Where the approval mark on the light source module differs from the one on the lamp in which the module is used, both marks shall be from the same applicant.
requirements.quote: The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant;

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with light source module(s), the light source module(s) shall bear a marking indicating the rated voltage or the range of voltage.
requirements.quote: (c) The rated voltage or the range of voltage.

requirements.text: Where an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), the electronic light source control gear shall be marked with its specific identification code.
requirements.quote: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), it shall be marked with its specific identification code and the rated input voltage or range of voltage;

requirements.text: Where an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), the electronic light source control gear shall be marked with the rated input voltage or range of voltage.
requirements.quote: In the case an electronic light source control gear, which is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, is used to operate a light source or a light source module(s), it shall be marked with its specific identification code and the rated input voltage or range of voltage;

requirements.text: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp.
requirements.quote: The Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp.

requirements.text: The lamp shall be so installed that the Unique Identifier or the approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.quote: In any case, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: When the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened, the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible.
requirements.quote: In any case, the Unique Identifier or the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.

requirements.text: The lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.
requirements.quote: Lamps submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 and 6 and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations No. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations No. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible, the requirements pertinent to the lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The lamp shall be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which it may be subjected in such use, its satisfactory operation remains assured.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lamp shall be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which it may be subjected in such use, it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: Following the application of the measures described in paragraph 4.12.1., the following requirements regarding the luminous intensity of the lamp shall be met with the adjustment left unchanged compared to that for the original traffic direction:
requirements.quote: Following the application of the measures described in paragraph 4.12.1. the following requirements regarding the luminous intensity of the lamp shall be met with the adjustment left unchanged compared to that for the original traffic direction:

requirements.text: Following the application of the measures described in paragraph 4.12.1., for a passing-beam designed for right-hand traffic and adapted to left-hand traffic, at 0.86°D - 1.72°L the luminous intensity of the lamp shall be at least 2.50∙10^3 cd, with the adjustment left unchanged compared to that for the original traffic direction.
requirements.quote: Passing-beam designed for right-hand traffic and adapted to left-hand traffic: at 0.86°D - 1.72°L at least 2.50∙10^3 cd

requirements.text: Following the application of the measures described in paragraph 4.12.1., for a passing-beam designed for right-hand traffic and adapted to left-hand traffic, at 0.57°U - 3.43°R the luminous intensity of the lamp shall be not more than 8.80∙10^2 cd, with the adjustment left unchanged compared to that for the original traffic direction.
requirements.quote: at 0.57°U - 3.43°R not more than 8.80∙10^2 cd.

requirements.text: Following the application of the measures described in paragraph 4.12.1., for a passing-beam designed for left-hand traffic and adapted to right-hand traffic, at 0.86°D - 1.72°R the luminous intensity of the lamp shall be at least 2.50∙10^3 cd, with the adjustment left unchanged compared to that for the original traffic direction.
requirements.quote: Passing-beam designed for left-hand traffic and adapted to right-hand traffic: at 0.86° D -1.72°R at least 2.50∙10^3 cd

requirements.text: Following the application of the measures described in paragraph 4.12.1., for a passing-beam designed for left-hand traffic and adapted to right-hand traffic, at 0.57°U - 3.43°L the luminous intensity of the lamp shall be not more than 8.80∙10^2 cd, with the adjustment left unchanged compared to that for the original traffic direction.
requirements.quote: at 0.57°U - 3.43°L not more than 8.80∙10^2 cd.

requirements.text: If required by the provisions of the relevant UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, the device (lamp) shall be so made that, if a light source and/or a light source module has failed, a signal indicating the failure is provided.
requirements.quote: If required by the provisions of the relevant UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86 the device (lamp) shall be so made that, if a light source and/or a light source module has failed, a signal indicating the failure is provided.

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation (see definition of “light source” in UN Regulation No. 48) wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection of one or more of the following options.
requirements.quote: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation (see definition of “light source” in UN Regulation No. 48) wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection of one or more of the following options:

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, where one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light.
requirements.quote: (a) One or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light;

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, where, as a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous intensity value in any of the photometric requirements is less than 80% of the minimum luminous intensity value required for the type approval.
requirements.quote: (b) As a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous intensity value in any of the photometric requirements is less than 80% of the minimum luminous intensity value required for the type approval;

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, where, as a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous flux value has changed by more than 5% compared to the luminous flux value when no failure occurs.
requirements.quote: (c) As a consequence of one or more element(s) for visible radiation stops emitting light, the resulting luminous flux value has changed by more than 5% compared to the luminous flux value when no failure occurs;

requirements.text: In case a specific function, which is realised with more than one element for visible radiation wired so that a failure of any one of them does not cause all of them to stop emitting light, a signal indicating the failure of that specific function shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, where more than 5% of the elements for visible radiation stop emitting light.
requirements.quote: (d) More than 5% of the elements for visible radiation stop emitting light.

requirements.text: In case more than one light source is used, the option (d) provision shall apply to the sum of all elements and to the elements of each light source separately.
requirements.quote: In case more than one light source is used, this provision applies to the sum of all elements and to the elements of each light source separately.

requirements.text: Where fitted, a signal indicating the failure of a specific function realised with more than one element for visible radiation shall be provided, according to the applicant’s selection, when one or more UN approved light source(s) stops emitting light.
requirements.quote: (e) If fitted, one or more UN approved light source(s) stops emitting light.

requirements.text: When a replaceable light source is assembled, the component(s) to which it is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily.
requirements.quote: The component(s) to which a replaceable light source is assembled shall be so made that the light source fits easily

requirements.text: When a replaceable light source is assembled, the component(s) to which it is assembled shall be so made that, even in darkness, the light source can be fitted in no position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: and, even in darkness, can be fitted in no position but the correct one.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with replaceable light sources, the lamp shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source.
requirements.quote: In the case of lamps with replaceable light sources, the lamp shall be considered acceptable if it meets the requirements of paragraph 5. with at least one standard (étalon) light source, which may be submitted with the lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be white for all lamps, except that for front fog lamps the colour of the light emitted may be selective yellow if requested by the applicant.
requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be white for all lamps. However, for front fog lamps the colour of the light emitted may be selective yellow if requested by the applicant.

requirements.text: In the case of headlamps or AFS with adjustable reflector, additional tests shall be made after the reflector/system or part(s) thereof has been moved vertically ±2° or at least into the maximum position, if less than 2°, from its initial position by means of the headlamps/systems or part(s) thereof adjusting device.
requirements.quote: Additional tests shall be made after the reflector/system or part(s) thereof has been moved vertically ±2° or at least into the maximum position, if less than 2°, from its initial position by means of the headlamps/systems or part(s) thereof adjusting device.

requirements.text: In the case of headlamps or AFS with adjustable reflector, having re-aimed the headlamp/system or part(s) thereof as a whole (by means of the goniometer for example) in the corresponding opposite direction, the light output in the following directions shall be controlled and lie within the required limits: passing-beam: for headlamp points B50L and 75R (B50R and 75L, respectively); for AFS points B50L and 75R, or 50R if applicable; for class AS, BS, CS and DS, points HV and 0.86D-V; driving-beam: Imax and point HV (percentage of Imax).
requirements.quote: Having re-aimed the headlamp/system or part(s) thereof as a whole (by means of the goniometer for example) in the corresponding opposite direction the light output in the following directions shall be controlled and lie within the required limits: passing-beam: for headlamp points B50L and 75R (B50R and 75L, respectively); for AFS points B50L and 75R, or 50R if applicable; for class AS, BS, CS and DS, points HV and 0.86D-V; driving-beam: Imax and point HV (percentage of Imax).

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so made that they give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting the passing-beam.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall be so made that they give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting the passing-beam, and good illumination when emitting the driving-beam.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so made that they give good illumination when emitting the driving-beam.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall be so made that they give adequate illumination without dazzle when emitting the passing-beam, and good illumination when emitting the driving-beam.

requirements.text: The lamp shall be fitted with a device enabling it to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to it.
requirements.quote: Lamps shall be fitted with a device enabling them to be so adjusted on the vehicles as to comply with the rules applicable to them.

requirements.text: In case of headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS, DS and of front fog lamps, the lamp shall be so designed that it can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.
requirements.quote: In case of headlamps of classes AS, BS, CS, DS and of front fog lamps, such a device may or may not provide horizontal adjustment, provided that the headlamps are so designed that they can maintain a proper horizontal aiming even after the vertical aiming adjustment.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval.
requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s).

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with light source module(s).
requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s).

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or - light source module(s) and/or - non-replaceable light source(s).

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), (a) The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
requirements.quote: (b) The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed shall apply.
requirements.quote: The holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed, applies.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) shall apply.
requirements.quote: In addition, where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applies.

requirements.text: The road illumination device shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Road illumination devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s); and (b) it is tamperproof;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s); and (b) it is tamperproof;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that (a) it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s); and (b) it is tamperproof;

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module(s) shall not be mechanically interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.quote: (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not mechanically interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module(s) shall not be mechanically interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.quote: (c) regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not mechanically interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source; and/or, - any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the lamp or AFS system shall be met.
requirements.quote: (d) when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the lamp or AFS system shall be met.

requirements.text: If applicable, the light source module(s) shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.
requirements.quote: If applicable, light source modules shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex 9.

requirements.text: In case of the principal passing-beam, the total objective luminous flux of all light sources producing the principle passing-beam shall be equal or greater than the minimum values shown in Table 3a.
requirements.quote: In case of the principal passing-beam either: (a) the total objective luminous flux of all light sources (UN approved light sources, light source modules and non-replaceable light sources) producing the principle passing-beam shall be equal or greater than the minimum values shown in Table 3a

requirements.text: In case of the principal passing-beam, as an alternative, the luminous flux in the principal passing-beam shall meet the requirements in zones I and II, as specified in Table 3b, when aimed according to paragraphs 3.2. (for classes V, C, AFS-C) and 3.3. (for all the other classes) in Annex 5.
requirements.quote: or (b) the luminous flux in the principal passing-beam shall meet the requirements in zones I and II, as specified in Table 3b, when aimed according to paragraphs 3.2. (for classes V, C, AFS-C) and 3.3. (for all the other classes) in Annex 5.

requirements.text: In case of the principal passing-beam, the total objective luminous flux of all light sources (UN approved light sources, light source modules and non-replaceable light sources) producing the principal passing-beam shall be equal or smaller than the maximum values shown in Table 4, if any.
requirements.quote: In case of the principle passing-beam the total objective luminous flux of all light sources (UN approved light sources, light source modules and non-replaceable light sources) producing the principle passing-beam shall be equal or smaller than the maximum values shown in Table 4, if any.

requirements.text: Additionally, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
requirements.quote: Additionally, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.

requirements.text: Where a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where a front fog lamp or a cornering lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.3 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.2 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28.0 V (24 Volt-Systems).

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear, in case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the voltage supplied at the input terminals of the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.quote: 4.6.2.2.1. in case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the voltage supplied at the input terminals of the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant;

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear, in the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux.
requirements.quote: 4.6.2.2.2. in the case of replaceable UN approved light sources the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear, in the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
requirements.quote: 4.6.2.2.2. in the case of replaceable UN approved light sources the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the lamp shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.
requirements.quote: 4.6.2.3.1. shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
requirements.quote: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the lamp may alternatively be tested by using one light source in each of the individual lamp holder positions operating at the reference/objective luminous flux and application of the sum of the measured luminous intensities for each direction.
requirements.quote: 4.6.2.3.2. alternatively, can be tested by using one light source in each of the individual lamp holder positions operating at the reference/objective luminous flux and application of the sum of the measured luminous intensities for each direction.

requirements.text: Except for cornering lamps and headlamps of classes AS, if the outer lens of the lamp is made of plastic material, tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.
requirements.quote: If the outer lens of the lamp is made of plastic material tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 8.

requirements.text: Except for cornering lamps and headlamps of classes AS, the UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3.
requirements.quote: The UV resistance of light transmitting components located inside a front fog lamp and made of plastic material shall be tested according to Annex 8, paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: Except for cornering lamps, the complementary tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.
requirements.quote: Except for cornering lamps, complementary tests shall be done according to the requirements in Annex 7 to ensure that in use there is no excessive change in photometric performance.

requirements.text: The headlamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.1. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.
requirements.quote: The headlamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.1. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4.

requirements.text: For devices where more than one light source is used to provide the driving-beam, these light sources shall be operated simultaneously to determine the maximum value of the luminous intensity (Imax).
requirements.quote: For devices where more than one light source is used to provide the driving-beam, these light sources shall be operated simultaneously to determine the maximum value of the luminous intensity (Imax).

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of the driving-beam, referring to Figures A4-II, A4-III or A4-IV, shall meet the requirements of Table 5.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity distribution of the driving-beam, referring to Figures A4-II, A4-III or A4-IV, shall meet the requirements of Table 5.

requirements.text: Except for classes BS, CS and DS, the point of intersection (HV) of lines H-H and V-V shall be situated within the isocandela 80 per cent of maximum luminous intensity (Imax)
requirements.quote: Except for classes BS, CS and DS, the point of intersection (HV) of lines H-H and V-V shall be situated within the isocandela 80 per cent of maximum luminous intensity (Imax)

requirements.text: The headlamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.2. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4, except that if vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the asymmetric "cut-off" line and to perform the beam vertical adjustment.
requirements.quote: The headlamp shall be aimed according to Annex 5, paragraph 3.2. including the allowed specific tolerances of paragraph 4. If, however, vertical adjustment cannot be performed repeatedly to the required position within the allowed tolerances, the instrumental method of Annex 6, paragraph 2. shall be applied to test compliance with the required minimum quality of the asymmetric "cut-off" line and to perform the beam vertical adjustment.

requirements.text: The passing-beam shall meet the luminous intensities at the test points referred to in Table 6 and in Figure A4-V.
requirements.quote: The passing-beam shall meet the luminous intensities at the test points referred to in Table 6 and in Figure A4-V.

requirements.text: The adaptive front-lighting system shall be so made that, when signal inputs according to paragraph 5.3.1.4.2. apply, the requirements of paragraph 5.3.2. shall be fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Other modes: When signal inputs according to paragraph 5.3.1.4.2. apply, the requirements of the paragraph 5.3.2. shall be fulfilled.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall not exhibit variations in homogeneity detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R.
requirements.quote: Variations in homogeneity detrimental to satisfactory visibility in the zone above the line 5 from 10°L to 10°R are not permitted.

requirements.text: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern of the front fog lamp should be substantially uniform.
requirements.quote: Inside the field between lines 1 to 5 in Figure A4-X, the beam pattern should be substantially uniform.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall not exhibit discontinuities in intensities detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9.
requirements.quote: Discontinuities in intensities detrimental to satisfactory visibility between the lines 6, 7, 8 and 9 are not permitted.

requirements.text: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 17, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 1.75∙10² cd are allowed, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
requirements.quote: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 17, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 1.75∙102 cd are allowed, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.

requirements.text: Where the luminous intensities of the front fog lamp are varied automatically, all intensities shall be varied proportionately.
requirements.quote: (b) All intensities are varied proportionately.

requirements.quote: The system, when checked for compliance according to the provisions of paragraph 4.6.2.1., is considered acceptable if the luminous intensities remain within 60 per cent and 100 per cent of the values specified in Table 17.

requirements.text: The Technical Service responsible for type approval shall verify that the front fog lamp function system provides automatic modifications, such that good road illumination is achieved.
requirements.quote: The Technical Service responsible for type approval shall verify that the system provides automatic modifications, such that good road illumination is achieved

requirements.text: The Technical Service responsible for type approval shall verify that the front fog lamp function system provides automatic modifications, such that no discomfort is caused to the driver or to other road users.
requirements.quote: and no discomfort is caused to the driver or to other road users.

requirements.text: The photometric measurements of the front fog lamp shall be performed according to the applicant's description.
requirements.quote: Photometric measurements shall be performed according to the applicant's description.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, no measured value of the mass-produced lamp shall deviate unfavorably by more than 20 per cent from the value prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise specified, no measured value deviates unfavorably by more than 20 per cent from the value prescribed in this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 19, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 2.10∙10² cd are allowed, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.
requirements.quote: In the light-distribution as specified in Table 19, single narrow spots or stripes inside the area including the measuring points 1 to 10 and line 1 or inside the area of line 1 and line 2 with not more than 2.10∙102 cd are allowed, if not extending beyond a conical angle of 2° aperture or a width of 1°.

requirements.text: Where multiple spots or stripes are present in the light-distribution as specified in Table 19, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.
requirements.quote: If multiple spots or stripes are present, they shall be separated by a minimum angle of 10°.

requirements.text: The alignment of the front fog lamp may be changed according to the provisions in Annex 5, paragraph 4.1, only if the results of the test described above do not meet the requirements.

requirements.text: With respect to the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, one of the sampled lamps or systems shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 7 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 7.
requirements.quote: One of the sampled lamps or systems shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 7 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 7

requirements.text: With respect to the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, the headlamp or system shall be considered as acceptable if "Δr" does not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: A headlamp or system shall be considered as acceptable if ∆r does not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and does not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.

requirements.text: With respect to the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line under the influence of heat, the headlamp or system shall be considered as acceptable if "Δr" does not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: A headlamp or system shall be considered as acceptable if ∆r does not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and does not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.

requirements.text: When the value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, a second sample shall be subjected to the test.
requirements.quote: If this value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, a second sample shall be subjected to the test

requirements.text: When the value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards

requirements.text: When the value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards

requirements.text: When the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on these two systems is not complied with, another two systems shall be subjected to the same procedure.
requirements.quote: if this value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on these two systems is not complied with, another two systems shall be subjected to the same procedure

requirements.text: When the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on these two systems is not complied with, the value of Δr for each of the other two systems shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: the value of ∆r for each of them shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards

requirements.text: When the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on these two systems is not complied with, the value of Δr for each of the other two systems shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: the value of ∆r for each of them shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if Δr does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
requirements.quote: A front fog lamp shall be considered as acceptable if ∆r does not exceed 3.0 mrad.

requirements.text: When the value of Δr of the front fog lamp exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, a second front fog lamp shall be subjected to the test.
requirements.quote: If this value exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, a second front fog lamp shall be subjected to the test

requirements.text: When the value of Δr of the front fog lamp exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, the mean of the absolute values recorded on both front fog lamps shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
requirements.quote: after which the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
requirements.quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.

requirements.text: When the sampled devices are subjected to photometric measurements, the reading of the front fog lamps according to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation shall be limited to the points 8 and 9 as specified in Table 19.
requirements.quote: For front fog lamps according to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, to the points 8 and 9, and the lines 1, 5, 6, 8 and 9 as specified in Table 19.

requirements.text: When the sampled devices are subjected to photometric measurements, the reading of the front fog lamps according to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation shall be limited to the lines 1, 5, 6, 8 and 9 as specified in Table 19.
requirements.quote: For front fog lamps according to paragraph 5.5. of this Regulation, to the points 8 and 9, and the lines 1, 5, 6, 8 and 9 as specified in Table 19.

requirements.text: For the verification of the change in vertical position of the cut-off line for passing-beam, one of the lamps or system of sample A shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 3. of Annex 7 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 7.
requirements.quote: One of the lamps or system of sample A shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 3. of Annex 7 after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle described in paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 7.

requirements.text: The passing-beam or the system shall be considered acceptable if Δr does not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: The passing-beam or the system shall be considered as acceptable if Δr does not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards

requirements.text: The passing-beam or the system shall be considered acceptable if Δr does not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: and does not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.

requirements.text: If Δr exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards, or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, a second system of sample A shall be subjected to the test.
requirements.quote: If this value exceeds 1.5 mrad but is not more than 2.0 mrad upwards or exceeds 2.5 mrad but is not more than 3.0 mrad downwards, a second system of sample A shall be subjected to the test

requirements.text: If a second system of sample A is tested, the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: after which the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 1.5 m rad upwards

requirements.text: If a second system of sample A is tested, the mean of the absolute values recorded on both samples shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.

requirements.text: If the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on sample A is not complied with, another two systems of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure.
requirements.quote: However, if this value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on sample A is not complied with, another two systems of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure

requirements.text: If the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on sample A is not complied with, the value of Δr for each of the two systems of sample B shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards.
requirements.quote: the value of Δr for each of them shall not exceed 1.5 mrad upwards

requirements.text: If the value of 1.5 mrad upwards and 2.5 mrad downwards on sample A is not complied with, the value of Δr for each of the two systems of sample B shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.
requirements.quote: and shall not exceed 2.5 mrad downwards.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps in accordance with paragraph 5.5. to this Regulation, the lamp shall be considered acceptable if r does not exceed 3.0 mrad.
requirements.quote: In the case of front fog lamps in accordance with paragraph 5.5. to this Regulation the lamp shall be considered as acceptable if r does not exceed 3.0 mrad.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps in accordance with paragraph 5.5. to this Regulation, if the value exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, the second front fog lamp of sample A shall be subjected to the test, after which the mean of the absolute values recorded in both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.
requirements.quote: If this value exceeds 3.0 mrad but is not more than 4.0 mrad, the second front fog lamp of sample A shall be subjected to the test after which the mean of the absolute values recorded in both samples shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.

requirements.text: In the case of front fog lamps in accordance with paragraph 5.5. to this Regulation, if the value of 3.0 mrad on sample A is not complied with, the two front fog lamps of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure.
requirements.quote: However, if this value of 3.0 mrad on sample A is not complied with, the two front fog lamps of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure

requirements.quote: and the value of r for each of them shall not exceed 3.0 mrad.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity values shall be determined by means of a photoreceptor contained within a square of 65 mm side and, except for cornering lamps, set up to a distance of at least 25 m forward of the centre of reference of each headlamp or lighting unit perpendicular to the measurement axis from the origin of the goniometer.
requirements.quote: The luminous intensity values shall be determined by means of a photoreceptor contained within a square of 65 mm side and, except for cornering lamps, set up to a distance of at least 25 m forward of the centre of reference of each headlamp or lighting unit perpendicular to the measurement axis from the origin of the goniometer.

requirements.text: The asymmetric “cut-off” line shall provide, for right hand traffic beams (see Figure A5-I): (i) a straight “horizontal part” towards the left; (ii) a raised “elbow - shoulder” part towards the right.
requirements.quote: The asymmetric “cut-off” line shall provide: (a) For right hand traffic beams (see Figure A5-I): (i) A straight “horizontal part” towards the left; (ii) A raised “elbow - shoulder” part towards the right.

requirements.text: The asymmetric “cut-off” line shall provide, for left hand traffic beams: (i) a straight “horizontal part” towards the right; (ii) a raised “elbow - shoulder” part towards the left.
requirements.quote: (b) For left hand traffic beams: (i) A straight “horizontal part” towards the right; (ii) A raised “elbow - shoulder” part towards the left.

requirements.text: The “elbow-shoulder” part of the asymmetric “cut-off” line shall have a sharp edge.
requirements.quote: In each case the “elbow-shoulder” part shall have a sharp edge.

requirements.text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off" (see Figure A5-II) as follows.
requirements.quote: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be visually aimed by means of the "cut-off" (see Figure A5-II) as follows.

requirements.text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp, the device shall be horizontally adjusted according to paragraph 3.3.1.2.
requirements.quote: For horizontal adjustment: according to paragraph 3.3.1.2.

requirements.text: In the case of a road illumination device providing a front fog lamp designed for use in pairs or having otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the front fog lamp shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.quote: When the front fog lamp is designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, it shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant, or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.text: To determine the minimum sharpness, the measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° at a measurement distance of 10 m with a detector having a diameter of approximately 10 mm.
requirements.quote: To determine the minimum sharpness, measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° at either a measurement distance of: (a) 10 m with a detector having a diameter of approximately 10 mm

requirements.text: To determine the minimum sharpness, the measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° at a measurement distance of 25 m with a detector having a diameter of approximately 30 mm.
requirements.quote: or (b) 25 m with a detector having a diameter of approximately 30 mm.

requirements.text: The measuring distance at which the test was carried out shall be recorded in item 9. of the communication form (see Annex 1 to this Regulation).
requirements.quote: The measuring distance at which the test was carried out shall be recorded in item 9. of the communication form (see Annex 1 to this Regulation).

requirements.text: To determine the maximum sharpness and linearity, the measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° exclusively at a measurement distance of 25 m and with a detector having a diameter of approximately 30 mm.
requirements.quote: To determine the maximum sharpness and linearity, measurements shall be performed by vertically scanning through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" in angular steps of 0.05° exclusively at a measurement distance of 25 m and with a detector having a diameter of approximately 30 mm.

requirements.text: The "cut-off" quality shall be considered acceptable if the requirements of paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.3. comply with at least one set of measurements.
requirements.quote: The "cut-off" quality shall be considered acceptable if the requirements of paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.3. comply with at least one set of measurements.

requirements.text: Not more than one “cut-off” shall be visible.
requirements.quote: Not more than one “cut-off” shall be visible1

requirements.text: The sharpness factor G of the front fog lamp shall be determined by scanning vertically through the horizontal part of the “cut-off” at 2.5° from the V-V line for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line.
requirements.quote: The sharpness factor G is determined by scanning vertically through the horizontal part of the "cut-off" at: (a) 2.5° from the V-V line for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric

requirements.text: The sharpness factor G of the front fog lamp shall be determined by scanning vertically through the horizontal part of the “cut-off” at 2.5° left and right from the V-V line for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line.
requirements.quote: (b) 2.5° left and right from the V-V line for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line

requirements.text: The value of G shall not be less than 0.13 (minimum sharpness) for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line.
requirements.quote: The value of G shall not be less than: (a) 0.13 (minimum sharpness) for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line

requirements.text: The value of G of the front fog lamp shall not be less than 0.08 (minimum sharpness) for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line.
requirements.quote: (b) 0.08 (minimum sharpness) for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line

requirements.text: The value of G shall not be greater than 0.40 (maximum sharpness) for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line.
requirements.quote: and not greater than 0.40 (maximum sharpness) for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line.

requirements.text: The part of the horizontal “cut-off” that serves for vertical adjustment shall be horizontal between 1.5° and 3.5° from the V-V line for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line (see Figure A6-I).
requirements.quote: (a) For passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line the part of the horizontal "cut-off" that serves for vertical adjustment shall be horizontal between 1.5° and 3.5° from the V-V line

requirements.text: For passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line, the part of the horizontal “cut-off” shall be horizontal between 3° left and right from the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).
requirements.quote: (b) For passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line the part of the horizontal "cut-off" shall be horizontal between 3° left and right from the V-V line

requirements.text: The inflection points of the “cut-off” gradient at the vertical lines at 1.5°, 2.5° and 3.5° shall be determined by the equation: (d2 (log E) / dβ2 = 0).
requirements.quote: The inflection points of the "cut-off" gradient at the vertical lines at 1.5°, 2.5° and 3.5° shall be determined by the equation: (d2 (log E) / dβ2 = 0).

requirements.text: The maximum vertical distance between the inflection points determined shall not exceed 0.2° for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line.
requirements.quote: The maximum vertical distance between the inflection points determined shall not exceed: (a) 0.2° for passing-beam designed to provide asymmetric “cut-off” line

requirements.text: The maximum vertical distance between the inflection points determined shall not exceed 0.5° for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line.
requirements.quote: (b) 0.5° for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line

requirements.text: When the "cut-off" complies with the quality requirements of paragraph 2.2., the vertical scan for a front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line shall be carried out on the V-V line (see Figure A6-II).
requirements.quote: (b) on the V-V line for passing-beam and front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric "cut-off" line (see Figure A6-II)

requirements.text: The inflection point of a front fog lamp shall be determined and positioned on the line B situated 1° below H-H line.
requirements.quote: (b) 1° below H-H line for front fog lamp

requirements.text: For passing-beam headlamp or front fog lamp designed to provide symmetric “cut-off” line, the cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.quote: The cut-off line shall be so positioned that the projected beam pattern appears approximately symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.text: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or having otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the “cut-off” line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant.
requirements.quote: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or has otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the “cut-off” line shall be horizontally aligned according to the specification of the applicant

requirements.text: In case of front fog lamps designed for use in pairs or having otherwise an asymmetric beam pattern, the “cut-off” line shall be horizontally aligned in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.
requirements.quote: or otherwise in such a way that the cut-off line appears symmetrical to the V-V line.

requirements.quote: (a) In the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam or AFS: Imax for driving-beam and in points 40L, 50R, B50L for passing-beam (or 40R, 50L, B50R for headlamps designed for left-hand traffic)

requirements.text: Once the photometric values have been measured according to this Regulation, for a headlamp with a symmetrical passing-beam, the complete Road Illumination Device shall be tested at Imax for driving-beam and at points 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R, 50R, 50L for Class BS passing-beam.
requirements.quote: (b) In the case of a headlamp with a symmetrical passing-beam: Imax for driving-beam and in points 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R, 50R, 50L for Class BS passing-beam

requirements.text: Once the photometric values have been measured according to this Regulation, for a headlamp with a symmetrical passing-beam of Classes CS and DS, the complete Road Illumination Device shall be tested at points 0.86°D-3.5°R and 0.86°D-3.5°L.
