requirements.text: Once the photometric values have been measured according to this Regulation, for front fog lamps, the complete Road Illumination Device shall be tested at the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and at the point HV.
requirements.quote: (c) In the case of front fog lamps: at the point of maximum illumination in zone D (Imax) and in the point HV

requirements.text: A complete sample shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.
requirements.quote: A complete sample shall be tested for stability of photometric performance in operation.

requirements.text: "Complete sample" shall be understood to mean the complete lamp itself including ballast(s) and those surrounding body parts, light sources or light source module(s) which could influence its thermal dissipation.
requirements.quote: "Complete sample" shall be understood to mean the complete lamp itself including ballast(s) and those surrounding body parts, light sources or light source module(s) which could influence its thermal dissipation.

requirements.text: The device shall be operated for 12 hours as described in paragraph 2.1.1.
requirements.quote: The device shall be operated for 12 hours as described in paragraph 2.1.1.

requirements.text: The device shall be checked as prescribed in paragraph 2.1.2.
requirements.quote: and checked as prescribed in paragraph 2.1.2.

requirements.text: In the case where a device is designed to provide only one lighting function and not more than one class in case of passing-beam, the corresponding light emitting element(s) shall be lit for the time specified in paragraph 2.1.
requirements.quote: (a) In the case where a device is designed to provide only one lighting function (driving-beam or passing-beam or front fog lamp) and not more than one class in case of passing-beam, the corresponding light emitting element (s) is/are lit for the time2 specified in paragraph 2.1.

requirements.text: In the case where a device is designed to provide two or more lighting functions, the device shall be subjected to the cycle of 15 minutes main mode lit until the time specified is reached.
requirements.quote: (b) In the case where a device is designed to provide two or more lighting functions, the device shall be subjected to the following cycle until the time specified is reached as follows: - 15 minutes, main mode lit

requirements.text: In the case where a device is designed to provide two or more lighting functions, the device shall be subjected to the cycle of 5 minutes with all other functions which, according to the manufacturer's specifications, in the same body are intended to be used simultaneously and which, in combination draw the highest total wattage lit.
requirements.quote: - 5 minutes, all other functions which, according to the manufacturer's specifications, in the same body are intended to be used simultaneously2 and which, in combination draw the highest total wattage lit

requirements.text: In the case of a passing-beam designed to provide bend lighting with the addition of light source(s) or light source module(s), the light source(s) or light source module(s) shall be switched ON for one minute, and switched OFF for nine minutes during the activation of the passing-beam only.
requirements.quote: (c) In the case of a passing-beam designed to provide bend lighting with the addition of light source(s) or light source module(s), it/they shall be switched ON for one minute, and switched OFF for nine minutes during the activation of the passing-beam only.

requirements.text: In the case of a passing-beam designed to provide bend lighting with several additional light sources, the test shall be carried out with the combination of light source(s) that represents the most severe operating condition.
requirements.quote: If the headlamp has several additional light sources used to produce bend lighting, the test shall be carried out with the combination of light source(s) that represents the most severe operating condition.

requirements.text: In the case of a headlamp equipped with cornering lamp with the addition of light source(s) or light source module(s), the light source(s) or light source module(s) shall be switched ON for one minute, and switched OFF for nine minutes during the activation of the passing-beam only.
requirements.quote: (d) In the case of a headlamp equipped with cornering lamp with the addition of light source(s) or light source module(s), it /they shall be switched ON for one minute, and switched OFF for nine minutes during the activation of the passing-beam only.

requirements.text: In the case that the driving-beam uses several light sources and the applicant declares that a part of the driving-beam will be used exclusively for short time signals (flash to pass), the test shall be carried out without this part of the driving-beam.
requirements.quote: (e) In the case that the driving-beam uses several light sources and if the applicant declares that a part of the driving-beam (one of these additional light sources) will be used exclusively for short time signals (flash to pass), the test shall be carried out without this part of the driving-beam.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable filament light source(s) operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions, the test shall be performed at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V as applicable.
requirements.quote: (a) In case of replaceable filament light source(s) operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions: The test shall be performed at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V as applicable

requirements.text: In case of replaceable filament light source(s) operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions, where the applicant specifies that the test sample may be used at a different voltage, the test shall be carried out with the filament light source operated at the highest voltage that can be used.
requirements.quote: except if the applicant specifies that the test sample may be used at a different voltage. In this case, the test shall be carried out with the filament light source operated at the highest voltage that can be used.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable gas discharge light source(s), the test voltage for the electronic light source control-gear or the light source is 13.2 ±0.1 volts for 12 V vehicle voltage system.
requirements.quote: (b) In case of replaceable gas discharge light source(s): The test voltage for the electronic light source control-gear or the light source, in case the ballast is integrated with the light source, is 13.2 ±0.1 volts for 12 V vehicle voltage system

requirements.text: In case of replaceable gas discharge light source(s), the test voltage shall be as otherwise specified in the application for approval.
requirements.quote: or otherwise specified in the application for approval.

requirements.text: In the case of non-replaceable light source operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions, all measurements shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V.
requirements.quote: (c) In the case of non-replaceable light source operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions: All measurements on lighting units equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and/ or others) shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V

requirements.text: In the case of non-replaceable light source operated directly under vehicle voltage system conditions, all measurements shall be made at other voltages according to the vehicle voltage system as specified by the applicant.
requirements.quote: or at other voltages according to the vehicle voltage system as specified by the applicant respectively.

requirements.text: In the case of light sources being operated independently from vehicle supply voltage and fully controlled by the system, the test voltages shall be applied to the input terminals of that device.
requirements.quote: the test voltages as specified above shall be applied to the input terminals of that device.

requirements.text: In the case of LED light source(s) and light source module(s), the measurement shall be made at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V respectively, if not otherwise specified within the pertinent Regulation.
requirements.quote: (e) LED light source(s) and light source module(s) shall be measured at 6.3 V, 13.2 V or 28.0 V respectively, if not otherwise specified within the pertinent Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case of LED light source(s) and light source module(s) operated by an electronic light source control gear, the measurement shall be made as specified by the applicant.
requirements.quote: LED light source(s) and light source module(s) operated by an electronic light source control gear, shall be measured as specified by the applicant.

requirements.text: Where signalling lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated into the test sample and operating at voltages other than the nominal rated voltages of 6 V, 12 V or 24 V respectively, the voltage shall be adjusted as declared by the manufacturer for the correct photometric functioning of that lamp.
requirements.quote: (f) Where signalling lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated into the test sample and operating at voltages other than the nominal rated voltages of 6 V, 12 V or 24 V respectively, the voltage shall be adjusted as declared by the manufacturer for the correct photometric functioning of that lamp.

requirements.text: For a gas-discharge light source, the test voltage for the ballast or for the light source is 13.2 ± 0.1 volts for 12 V network system, or otherwise specified in the application for approval.
requirements.quote: (g) For a gas-discharge light source, the test voltage for the ballast or for the light source in case the ballast is integrated with the light source is 13.2 ± 0.1 volts for 12 V network system, or otherwise specified in the application for approval.

requirements.text: Once the headlamp has been stabilized to the ambient temperature, the headlamp lens and the external lens, if any, shall be cleaned with a clean, damp cotton cloth.
requirements.quote: Once the headlamp has been stabilized to the ambient temperature, the headlamp lens and the external lens, if any, shall be cleaned with a clean, damp cotton cloth.

requirements.text: Once the headlamp has been stabilized to the ambient temperature, the headlamp shall be inspected visually.
requirements.quote: It shall then be inspected visually

requirements.text: Once the headlamp has been stabilized to the ambient temperature, no distortion, deformation, cracking or change in colour of either the headlamp lens or the external lens, if any, shall be noticeable.
requirements.quote: no distortion, deformation, cracking or change in colour of either the headlamp lens or the external lens, if any, shall be noticeable.

requirements.text: To comply with the requirements, in the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam pattern for right-hand traffic, the passing-beam photometric values shall be verified at points 50R, B50L and 40L.
requirements.quote: - 50R - B50L - 40L for headlamps designed for right-hand traffic;

requirements.text: To comply with the requirements, in the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam pattern for left-hand traffic, the passing-beam photometric values shall be verified at points 50L, B50R and 40R.
requirements.quote: - 50L - B50R - 40R for headlamps designed for left-hand traffic.

requirements.text: To comply with the requirements, in the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam pattern, the driving-beam photometric values shall be verified at Imax.
requirements.quote: (b) Driving-beam: Imax

requirements.text: To comply with the requirements, in the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam pattern, except for point B50L, the photometric characteristics shall not deviate by more than 10 per cent from the values measured prior to the test, including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
requirements.quote: Except for point B50L, a 10 per cent discrepancy between the photometric characteristics and the values measured prior to the test is permissible including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.

requirements.text: To comply with the requirements, in the case of a headlamp with an asymmetrical passing-beam pattern, the value measured at point B50L shall not exceed the photometric value measured prior to the test by more than 1.70∙102 cd.
requirements.quote: The value measured at point B50L shall not exceed the photometric value measured prior to the test by more than 1.70∙102 cd.

requirements.text: When the headlamp has a symmetrical passing-beam pattern and is a Class BS headlamp, the photometric values shall be verified in the passing-beam at points 50R, 50L, 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R.
requirements.quote: Class BS headlamp: - Passing-beam: 50R - 50L - 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R.

requirements.text: When the headlamp has a symmetrical passing-beam pattern and is a Class BS headlamp, the photometric values shall be verified in the driving-beam at point Imax.
requirements.quote: Class BS headlamp: - Passing-beam: 50R - 50L - 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R. - Driving-beam: Imax

requirements.text: When the headlamp has a symmetrical passing-beam pattern and is a Class CS or DS headlamp, the photometric values shall be verified in the passing-beam at points 0.86°D/3.5°R, 0.86°D/3.5°L, 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R.
requirements.quote: For Classes CS and DS headlamp: - Passing-beam: 0.86°D/3.5°R - 0.86°D/3.5°L - 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R.

requirements.text: When the headlamp has a symmetrical passing-beam pattern and is a Class CS or DS headlamp, the photometric values shall be verified in the driving-beam at point Imax.
requirements.quote: For Classes CS and DS headlamp: - Passing-beam: 0.86°D/3.5°R - 0.86°D/3.5°L - 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R. - Driving-beam: Imax

requirements.text: When the headlamp has a symmetrical passing-beam pattern, the value measured at points 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R shall not exceed the photometric value measured prior to the test by more than 2.55∙10² cd.
requirements.quote: The value measured at points 0.50°U/1.5°L and 0.50°U/1.5°R shall not exceed the photometric value measured prior to the test by more than 2.55∙10² cd.

requirements.text: When the device is a front fog lamp, the photometric values shall be verified at point HV and Imax in zone D.
requirements.quote: In the case of front fog lamps on point HV and Imax in zone D.

requirements.text: Where a front fog lamp, a headlamp producing a passing-beam, or an AFS is tested, the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat shall not exceed a specified value.
requirements.quote: This test consists of verifying that the vertical drift of the cut-off line under the influence of heat does not exceed a specified value for an operating headlamp producing a passing-beam, for front fog lamps, or in the case of an AFS for a system or part(s) of emitting a class C (basic) passing-beam, or each specified passing-beam mode.

requirements.text: The device tested in accordance with paragraph 2. shall be subjected to the test described in paragraph 3.1., without being removed from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.
requirements.quote: The device tested in accordance with paragraph 2., shall be subjected to the test described in paragraph 3.1., without being removed from or readjusted in relation to its test fixture.

requirements.text: If the AFS consists of more than one lighting unit or more than one assembly of lighting units which provide a cut-off, each of these shall be tested separately as a test sample.
requirements.quote: If the AFS consists of more than one lighting unit or more than one assembly of lighting units which provide a cut-off, each of these is understood to be a test sample for the purpose of this test and must be tested separately.

requirements.text: If the AFS has a moving optical part, only the position closest to the average vertical angular stroke and/or the initial position according to the neutral state shall be chosen for this test.
requirements.quote: If the AFS has a moving optical part, only the position closest to the average vertical angular stroke and/or the initial position according to the neutral state is chosen for this test.

requirements.text: The test shall be confined to signal input conditions corresponding to a straight road, only.
requirements.quote: The test is confined to signal input conditions corresponding to a straight road, only.

requirements.text: When testing front fog lamps, the position of the cut-off line between a point situated 3.0° left and a point situated 3.0° right of the cut-off line V-V shall be verified 3 minutes (r3) and 60 minutes (r60) respectively after operation.
requirements.quote: shall be verified 3 minutes (r3) and 60 minutes (r60) respectively after operation.

requirements.text: The measurement of the variation in the cut-off line position shall be carried out by any method giving acceptable accuracy and reproducible results.
requirements.quote: The measurement of the variation in the cut-off line position as described above shall be carried out by any method giving acceptable accuracy and reproducible results.

requirements.text: The absolute value Δr1 = |r3 - r60| recorded on a headlamp or AFS shall be not more than 1.0 mrad (Δr1 ≤ 1.0 mrad) upward.
requirements.quote: (a) In case of headlamps or AFS, the absolute value Δ r1 = | r3 - r60 | recorded on the device is not more than 1.0 mrad (Δ r1 ≤ 1.0 mrad) upward

requirements.text: The absolute value Δr1 = |r3 - r60| recorded on a headlamp or AFS shall be not more than 2.0 mrad (Δr1 ≤ 2.0 mrad) downwards.
requirements.quote: and not more than 2.0 mrad (Δ r1 ≤ 2.0 mrad) downwards.

requirements.text: In case of front fog lamps, the absolute value Δr1 = |r3 - r60| recorded on this device shall be not more than 2.0 mrad (Δr1 ≤ 2.0 mrad).
requirements.quote: (b) In case of front fog lamps, the absolute value Δ r1 = | r3 - r60 | recorded on this device is not more than 2.0 mrad (Δ r1 ≤ 2.0 mrad).

requirements.text: If the result does not comply with the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1. and does not exceed the values in Table A7-1, a further sample mounted on a test fixture representative of the correct installation on the vehicle shall be tested as described in paragraph 3.1. after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle as described below, in order to stabilise the position of the mechanical parts of the device.
requirements.quote: However, if the result does not comply with the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1. and does not exceed the values in Table A7-1, a further sample mounted on a test fixture representative of the correct installation on the vehicle shall be tested as described in paragraph 3.1. after being subjected three consecutive times to the cycle as described below, in order to stabilise the position of the mechanical parts of the device:

requirements.text: The further sample shall be operated for one hour in each of the three consecutive cycles, with the voltage adjusted as specified in paragraph 2.1.1.2.
requirements.quote: (a) Operation of the device for one hour (the voltage shall be adjusted as specified in paragraph 2.1.1.2.);

requirements.text: The further sample shall be kept with the lamp switched OFF for one hour in each of the three consecutive cycles.
requirements.quote: (b) One hour period with the lamp switched OFF.

requirements.text: After these three cycles, the device shall be considered as acceptable if the absolute values Δr measured according to paragraph 3.2. on this further sample meet the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1.
requirements.quote: After these three cycles, the device shall be considered as acceptable if the absolute values Δr measured according to paragraph 3.2. on this further sample meet the requirements in paragraph 3.2.1.

requirements.text: Three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity change in accordance with the following programme: 3 hours at 40 °C ± 2 °C and 85-95 per cent RH.
requirements.quote: (a) 3 hours at 40 °C ± 2 °C and 85-95 per cent RH;

requirements.text: Three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity change in accordance with the following programme: 1 hour at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH.
requirements.quote: (b) 1 hour at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH;

requirements.text: Three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity change in accordance with the following programme: 15 hours at -30 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: (c) 15 hours at -30 °C ± 2 °C;

requirements.text: Three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to five cycles of temperature and humidity change in accordance with the following programme: 3 hours at 80 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: (e) 3 hours at 80 °C ± 2 °C;

requirements.text: Before this test, the samples shall be kept at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH for at least four hours.
requirements.quote: Before this test, the samples shall be kept at 23 °C ± 5 °C and 60-75 per cent RH for at least four hours.

requirements.text: The periods of one hour at 23 °C ± 5 °C shall include the periods of transition from one temperature to another which are needed in order to avoid thermal shock effects.
requirements.quote: Note: The periods of one hour at 23 °C ± 5 °C shall include the periods of transition from one temperature to another which are needed in order to avoid thermal shock effects.

requirements.text: The variation between the photometric values measured on each sample before and after the test shall not exceed 10 per cent including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.
requirements.quote: The variation between the photometric values measured on each sample before and after the test shall not exceed 10 per cent including the tolerances of the photometric procedure.

requirements.text: When testing resistance to atmospheric agents, the three new samples shall be exposed to radiation from a source having a spectral energy distribution similar to that of a black body at a temperature between 5,500 K and 6,000 K.
requirements.quote: Three new samples (lenses or samples of material) shall be exposed to radiation from a source having a spectral energy distribution similar to that of a black body at a temperature between 5,500 K and 6,000 K.

requirements.text: Appropriate filters shall be placed between the source and the samples so as to reduce as far as possible radiations with wave lengths smaller than 295 nm and greater than 2,500 nm.
requirements.quote: Appropriate filters shall be placed between the source and the samples so as to reduce as far as possible radiations with wave lengths smaller than 295 nm and greater than 2,500 nm.

requirements.text: The samples shall be exposed to an energetic illumination of 1,200 W/m2 ± 200 W/m2.
requirements.quote: The samples shall be exposed to an energetic illumination of 1,200 W/m2 ± 200 W/m2

requirements.text: The samples shall be exposed for a period such that the luminous energy that they receive is equal to 4,500 MJ/m2 ± 200 MJ/m2.
requirements.quote: for a period such that the luminous energy that they receive is equal to 4,500 MJ/m2 ± 200 MJ/m2.

requirements.text: Within the enclosure, the temperature measured on the black panel placed on a level with the samples shall be 50 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: Within the enclosure, the temperature measured on the black panel placed on a level with the samples shall be 50 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: In order to ensure a regular exposure, the samples shall revolve around the source of radiation at a speed between 1 and 5 1/min.
requirements.quote: In order to ensure a regular exposure, the samples shall revolve around the source of radiation at a speed between 1 and 5 1/min.

requirements.text: The samples shall be sprayed with distilled water of conductivity lower than 1 mS/m at a temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: The samples shall be sprayed with distilled water of conductivity lower than 1 mS/m at a temperature of 23 °C ± 5 °C

requirements.text: The samples shall be sprayed for 5 minutes and dried for 25 minutes in accordance with the following cycle.
requirements.quote: in accordance with the following cycle: spraying: 5 minutes; drying: 25 minutes.

requirements.text: The outer face of three samples (lenses or samples of material) shall be heated to 50 °C ± 5 °C before immersion.
requirements.quote: The outer face of three samples (lenses or samples of material) shall be heated to 50 °C ± 5 °C and then immersed for five minutes

requirements.text: The heated samples shall be immersed for five minutes in a mixture maintained at 23 °C ± 5 °C and composed of 99 parts distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent impurities and one part alkylaryl sulphonate.
requirements.quote: and then immersed for five minutes in a mixture maintained at 23 °C ± 5 °C and composed of 99 parts distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent impurities and one part alkylaryl sulphonate.

requirements.text: At the end of the test, the samples shall be dried at 50 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: At the end of the test, the samples shall be dried at 50 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: The surface of the samples shall be cleaned with a moist cloth.
requirements.quote: The surface of the samples shall be cleaned with a moist cloth.

requirements.text: The outer face of the three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to the uniform mechanical deterioration test by the method described in Appendix 3.
requirements.quote: The outer face of the three new samples (lenses) shall be subjected to the uniform mechanical deterioration test by the method described in Appendix 3.

requirements.text: After the mechanical deterioration test, the variation in transmission Δt shall be measured according to the procedure described in Appendix 2 in the area specified in paragraph 1.2.1.1.
requirements.quote: After this test, the variations: in transmission: Δt = , and in diffusion: Δd = , shall be measured according to the procedure described in Appendix 2 in the area specified in paragraph 1.2.1.1.

requirements.text: After the mechanical deterioration test, the variation in diffusion Δd shall be measured according to the procedure described in Appendix 2 in the area specified in paragraph 1.2.1.1.
requirements.quote: and in diffusion: Δd = , shall be measured according to the procedure described in Appendix 2 in the area specified in paragraph 1.2.1.1.

requirements.text: The mean value of the three samples shall be such that Δtm < 0.100.
requirements.quote: The mean value of the three samples shall be such that: Δtm < 0.100;

requirements.text: The mean value of the three samples shall be such that Δdm < 0.050.
When the device is a fog lamp, after the test the results of photometric measurements prescribed for lines 2 and 5 shall not exceed the maximum values prescribed by more than 30 per cent.
requirements.quote: In the case of fog lamps, after the test, the results of photometric measurements prescribed for lines 2 and 5 shall not exceed the maximum values prescribed by more than 30 per cent

requirements.text: The LED module(s) shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use.
requirements.quote: LED module(s) shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use.

requirements.text: The LED module(s) shall exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.
requirements.quote: They shall moreover exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.

requirements.text: The fixation elements shall be strong.
requirements.quote: The fixation elements shall be strong and firmly secured to the LED(s) and the LED module.

requirements.text: The fixation elements shall be firmly secured to the LED(s).
requirements.quote: The fixation elements shall be strong and firmly secured to the LED(s) and the LED module.

requirements.text: The fixation elements shall be firmly secured to the LED module.
requirements.quote: The fixation elements shall be strong and firmly secured to the LED(s) and the LED module.

requirements.text: The front bumper front-end module vehicle approval mark shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark consisting of:

requirements.text: The international approval mark affixed to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter E followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: 4.1.4.1.. A circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval;

requirements.text: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface which, with the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc., in the closed position, are either:.
requirements.quote: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface which, with the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc., in the closed position, are either:

requirements.text: With the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc. in the closed position, the parts of the external surface at a height of more than 2 metres shall not be subject to the provisions of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: At a height of more than 2 metres, or 5.1.2.

requirements.text: With the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc. in the closed position, the parts of the external surface below the floor line shall not be subject to the provisions of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Below the floor line, or 5.1.3.

requirements.text: With the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc. in the closed position, the parts of the external surface so located that, in their static condition as well as when in operation, they cannot be contacted by a sphere 100 mm in diameter shall not be subject to the provisions of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: So located that, in their static condition as well as when in operation, they cannot be contacted by a sphere 100 mm in diameter.

requirements.text: The external surface of the vehicle shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

requirements.text: The external surface of the vehicle shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.text: The protruding part of the external surface shall not have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: Where a part of the external surface protrudes less than 5 mm, the outward facing angles of such part shall be blunted, save where such part protrudes less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: Where protruding parts of the external surface are made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, they may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: Protruding parts of the external surface, made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
requirements.quote: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.

requirements.text: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.
requirements.quote: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.

requirements.text: Where the distance between two consecutive elements of a grille or gap of the front bumper front-end module is between 40 mm and 25 mm, the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.quote: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.

requirements.text: If the distance between two consecutive elements of a grille or gap of the front bumper front-end module is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.quote: However, if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps of the front bumper front-end module shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap of the front bumper front-end module shall be blunted.
requirements.quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.

requirements.text: Where the end of the bumper is turned in, the end of the bumper shall not be contactable by a 100 mm sphere.
requirements.quote: the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere

requirements.text: Where the end of the bumper is turned in, the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork shall not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.quote: the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward.
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.quote: and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers

requirements.text: Where parts on or of the bumper or bumper insets project less than 5 mm, the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to the bumper cover.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above does not apply to the bumper cover.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation shall remain applicable.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable.

requirements.text: When the vehicle is travelling in a straight line, no part of the wheels other than the tyres, situated above the horizontal plane passing through their axis of rotation shall project beyond the vertical projection, in a horizontal plane of the external surface or structure.
requirements.quote: When the vehicle is travelling in a straight line, no part of the wheels other than the tyres, situated above the horizontal plane passing through their axis of rotation shall project beyond the vertical projection, in a horizontal plane of the external surface or structure.

requirements.text: Where functional requirements so warrant, wheel discs which cover wheel and hub nuts may project beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure on condition that the radius of curvature of the surface of the projecting part is not less than 30 mm.
requirements.quote: However, if functional requirements so warrant, wheel discs which cover wheel and hub nuts may project beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure on condition that the radius of curvature of the surface of the projecting part is not less than 30 mm

requirements.text: Where functional requirements so warrant, the projection of wheel discs beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure shall in no case exceed 30 mm.
requirements.quote: and that the projection beyond the vertical projection of the external surface or structure in no case exceeds 30 mm.

requirements.text: The vehicle (separate technical unit) approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.
requirements.quote: Vehicle (separate technical unit) approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.

requirements.text: The vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation shall have affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, an international approval mark.
requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark consisting of:

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.quote: a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall consist of the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.
requirements.quote: the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:.
requirements.quote: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly.
requirements.quote: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices shall remain visible.
requirements.quote: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, if the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices is disturbed, the adjustment may be corrected to conform to the required specifications, provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment.
requirements.quote: Should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications, provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.quote: the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have no leaks which prevent normal functioning.
requirements.quote: The vehicle\u2019s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning;

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have no constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
requirements.quote: The vehicle\u2019s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning;

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.quote: their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall operate in a normal manner.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, where the parking-assist ultrasonic sensors are damaged, disoriented or broken by an impact carried out according to Annex 3, the basic braking and steering performance shall remain intact.
requirements.quote: They may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.

requirements.text: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.
requirements.quote: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.

requirements.text: The vehicle tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer.
requirements.quote: The tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer.

requirements.text: The brakes shall be disengaged and the transmission control shall be in neutral position.
requirements.quote: The brakes shall be disengaged and the transmission control shall be in neutral position.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle is equipped with hydro pneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or a device for automatic levelling according to load, the vehicle shall be tested in the normal running conditions specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Vehicles equipped with hydro pneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or a device for automatic levelling according to load shall be tested in the normal running conditions specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The impactor shall be of rigid construction, the impact contour being of hardened steel.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be of rigid construction, the impact contour being of hardened steel.

requirements.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
requirements.quote: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.

requirements.text: In the two vehicle-loading conditions, the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.
requirements.quote: In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.

requirements.text: The the reference height is 445 mm shall meet: The reference height is 445 mm.
requirements.quote: The reference height is 445 mm.

requirements.text: Where a pendulum is used, the distance between the pivot and the centre of percussion shall be at least 3.3 m.
requirements.quote: The distance between the pivot and the centre of percussion shall be at least 3.3 m.

requirements.text: Where a pendulum is used, the reference line shall coincide with the centre of percussion.
requirements.quote: The reference line shall coincide with the centre of percussion.

requirements.text: In the case of a parallelogram-suspended pendulum, the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m.
requirements.quote: In the case of a parallelogram-suspended pendulum, the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m.

requirements.text: For the impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the median plane of the impactor for the second impact shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first.
requirements.quote: for the second impact the median plane of the impactor shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first

requirements.text: For the impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the extremities of the impactor shall not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle during these impacts.
requirements.quote: provided that during these impacts the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The longitudinal impact test shall meet: The impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.
requirements.quote: The impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: (a) plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle

requirements.text: In the corner impact test, the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
requirements.quote: (b) the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).

requirements.text: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: If the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices shall enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The white light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: No account shall be taken of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: No account shall be taken of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle nor of reversing projections.

requirements.text: No account shall be taken of reversing projections.
requirements.quote: No account shall be taken of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle nor of reversing projections.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, the apparent surface of a red lamp shall not be directly visible to an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, the apparent surface of a white lamp shall not be directly visible to an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: When verifying paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., in case of doubt, the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, shall be not more than 0.25 cd per lamp, taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON, except that this requirement shall not apply to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON. This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.

requirements.text: When the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, their electrical connections shall be such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again.
requirements.quote: Their electrical connections are such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again

requirements.text: When the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5.
requirements.quote: The substituting lamp/function meets, for the respective position lamp, the requirements concerning: (a) The geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5

requirements.text: When the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution.
requirements.quote: (b) The minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution

requirements.text: When the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements in paragraph 5.12.1.2. shall be provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp.
requirements.quote: Appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements indicated in paragraph 5.12.1.2. above is provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, except that the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.

requirements.text: The main-beam headlamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Main-beam headlamp: White

requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Dipped-beam headlamp: White

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall emit white or selective yellow light.
requirements.quote: Front fog lamp: White or selective yellow

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Reversing lamp: White

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamp: Amber

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Hazard warning signal: Amber

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Stop lamp: Red

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall emit amber or red light.
requirements.quote: Emergency stop signal : Amber or red

requirements.text: The rear-end collision alert signal shall emit amber light.
requirements.quote: Rear-end collision alert signal: Amber

requirements.text: The rear registration plate lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Rear registration plate lamp: White

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Front position lamp: White

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear position lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear fog lamp: Red

requirements.text: The parking lamp shall emit white light in front, red at the rear, and amber if reciprocally incorporated in the side direction-indicator lamps or in the side-marker lamps.
requirements.quote: Parking lamp: White in front, red at the rear, amber if reciprocally incorporated in the side direction-indicator lamps or in the side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamp shall emit amber light, except that the rearmost side-marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Side-marker lamp: Amber; however the rearmost side- marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamp shall emit white light in front and red light at the rear.
requirements.quote: End-outline marker lamp: White in front, red at the rear

requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Daytime running lamp: White

requirements.text: The non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: The triangular rear retro-reflector shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, triangular: Red

requirements.text: The non-triangular front retro-reflector shall emit light identical to incident light.
requirements.quote: Front retro-reflector, non- triangular: Identical to incident light

requirements.text: The non-triangular side retro-reflector shall emit amber light, except that the rearmost side retro-reflector can be red if it is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear position lamp, the rear end outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop-lamp, the red rearmost side-marker lamp or the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular.
requirements.quote: Side retro-reflector, non- triangular: Amber; however the rearmost side retro-reflector can be red if it is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear position lamp, the rear end outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop-lamp, the red rearmost side-marker lamp or the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular.

requirements.text: The cornering lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Cornering lamp: White

requirements.text: The conspicuity marking shall emit white light to the front.
requirements.quote: Conspicuity marking: White to the front

requirements.text: The conspicuity marking shall emit white or yellow light to the side.
requirements.quote: White or yellow to the side

requirements.text: The conspicuity marking shall emit red or yellow light to the rear.
requirements.quote: Red or yellow to the rear.

requirements.text: The adaptive front-lighting system (AFS) shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS): White

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Exterior courtesy lamp: White

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamp shall comply, in addition, with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the exterior courtesy lamp.
requirements.quote: Exterior courtesy lamp: In addition, in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the exterior courtesy lamp.

requirements.text: The manoeuvring lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Manoeuvring lamp: White

requirements.text: The answer-back signal shall comply with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
requirements.quote: Answer-back signal: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

requirements.text: The reversing projection shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Reversing projection: White

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lamp may be installed on movable components only if the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
requirements.quote: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the normal position(s) of use, the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the movable components of the dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, shall not differ by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
requirements.quote: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.

requirements.text: If the value of the angular inclination is exceeded, each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: When the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors is in any fixed position different from the normal position of use, the apparent surface shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it.
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.

requirements.text: The lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of all other signalling devices.
requirements.quote: and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.quote: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: Where lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, except that when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF. requirements.text: When a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the single lamp shall be installed in such a way that the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that this requirement shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis

requirements.text: When a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the single lamp shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that this requirement shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.quote: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
