requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be not less than 350 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be not more than 1,500 mm above the ground, except that where the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed, the rear position lamp shall be not more than 2,100 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).

requirements.text: Where optional rear position lamps are installed, they shall be placed symmetrically with respect to the lamps.

requirements.text: Where optional rear position lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible.

requirements.text: Where optional rear position lamps are installed, they shall be not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamp, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON, and a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.quote: Tell-tale. Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON. However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp tell-tale shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.

requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).

requirements.text: The end-outline marker lamp in-width condition shall be deemed to have been met when the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane is not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: If because of the construction of the trailers this angle cannot be met by the mandatory retro-reflectors, then additional (supplementary) retro-reflectors shall be fitted, without the width limitation (paragraph 6.16.4.1. above), which shall, in conjunction with the mandatory retro-reflectors, give the necessary visibility angle.

requirements.text: If supplementary retro-reflectors are fitted, they shall, in conjunction with the mandatory retro-reflectors, give the necessary horizontal visibility angle.
requirements.quote: If because of the construction of the trailers this angle cannot be met by the mandatory retro-reflectors, then additional (supplementary) retro-reflectors shall be fitted, without the width limitation (paragraph 6.16.4.1. above), which shall, in conjunction with the mandatory retro-reflectors, give the necessary visibility angle.

requirements.text: The front retro-reflector, non-triangular shall provide a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Where a front retro-reflector, non-triangular is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall be switched ON automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it possible for the propulsion system to operate and the front fog lamps are not switched ON.
requirements.quote: The daytime running lamps shall be switched ON automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it possible for the propulsion system to operate and neither of the following exist: (a) The front fog lamps are switched ON;

requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall be switched ON automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it possible for the propulsion system to operate and the headlamps are not manually switched ON, except when they are used to give intermittent luminous warnings at short intervals.
requirements.quote: (b) The headlamps are manually switched ON, except when they are used to give intermittent luminous warnings at short intervals;

requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall be switched ON automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it possible for the propulsion system to operate and the conditions of Annex 13 for automatic switching ON of dipped-beam headlamps do not exist.
requirements.quote: (c) Conditions of Annex 13 for automatic switching ON of dipped-beam headlamps exist.

requirements.text: When the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate, the daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically.
requirements.quote: The daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate as well as when either of the following conditions exists: (a) The front fog lamps are switched ON;

requirements.text: When the front fog lamps are switched ON, the daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically.
requirements.quote: (a) The front fog lamps are switched ON;

requirements.text: When the headlamps are manually switched ON, except when they are used to give intermittent luminous warnings at short intervals, the daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically.
requirements.quote: (b) The headlamps are manually switched ON, except when they are used to give intermittent luminous warnings at short intervals;

requirements.text: When conditions of Annex 13 for automatic switching ON of dipped-beam headlamps exist, the daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically.
requirements.quote: (c) Conditions of Annex 13 for automatic switching ON of dipped-beam headlamps exist.

requirements.text: If a front direction-indicator lamp is not reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp and the distance between the edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and the daytime running lamp is equal or less than 40 mm, the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that the daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: If a front direction-indicator lamp is not reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp and the distance between the edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and the daytime running lamp is equal or less than 40 mm, the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that, either (a) The daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp;

requirements.text: If a front direction-indicator lamp is not reciprocally incorporated with a daytime running lamp and the distance between the edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and the daytime running lamp is equal or less than 40 mm, the electrical connections of the daytime running lamp shall be such that the luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is reduced during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp, to attain not more than 140 cd within the angles of geometric visibility.
requirements.quote: or (b) The luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle is reduced during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the front direction-indicator lamp, to attain not more than 140 cd within the angles of geometric visibility.

requirements.text: If the luminous intensity of the front direction-indicator lamp in HV is at least 50% higher than the luminous intensity of the daytime running lamp in HV, the applicant shall demonstrate compliance with a concise description or other means acceptable to the Type Approval Authority.
requirements.quote: In this case the applicant shall demonstrate compliance with a concise description or other means acceptable to the Type Approval Authority.

requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamp shall be number two, type approved according to Class C of the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type approved according to Class C of the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149

requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamps shall be not less than 500 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 500 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be number two, Class “F3”.
requirements.quote: Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19.
requirements.quote: Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.text: As an alternative, the front fog lamp shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.quote: or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be positioned such that the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: Minimum: Not less than 250 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 800 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: Maximum: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: not more than 800 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For all other categories except N3G (off-road) vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: For all other categories except N3G (off-road)12 vehicles: not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For category N3G vehicles, the maximum height of the front fog lamp may be increased to 1,500 mm.
requirements.quote: For category N3G vehicles: the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: No point on the apparent surface of the front fog lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.
requirements.quote: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be located at the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be deemed to satisfy the length position requirement if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 5° upwards and downwards.
requirements.quote: Geometric visibility Defined by angles α and ß as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 5° upwards and downwards

requirements.text: The front fog lamp geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° outwards.
requirements.quote: ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 10° inwards.
requirements.quote: ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.text: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.
requirements.quote: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be oriented toward the front.
requirements.quote: Orientation Toward the front.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp does not exceed 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be –1.0 per cent or lower.
requirements.quote: The vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be – 1.0 per cent or lower.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamp shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent where the mounting height h in metres of the lower edge of the apparent surface is h > 0.8 (limits).
requirements.quote: h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the initial aiming of the vertical inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamp shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent where the mounting height h in metres of the lower edge of the apparent surface is h > 0.8.
requirements.quote: Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.

requirements.text: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer

requirements.text: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: shall be indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation

requirements.text: The value of the indicated downward inclination of the cut-off shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: The value of this indicated downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, the levelling device shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, it shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.
requirements.quote: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp levelling device may also be used to automatically adapt the inclination of the front fog beam in relation to the prevailing ambient conditions, provided that the limits for the downward inclination specified in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1. are not exceeded.
requirements.quote: The levelling device may also be used to automatically adapt the inclination of the front fog beam in relation to the prevailing ambient conditions, provided that the limits for the downward inclination specified in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1. are not exceeded.

requirements.text: In the case of a failure of the front fog lamp levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut-off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.
requirements.quote: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps shall be switchable ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, unless the front fog lamps cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated as indicated by the relevant symbol (/) according to paragraph 10.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. 19 or item 9.5.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. [RID].
requirements.quote: It shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, unless: (a) The front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS

requirements.text: Where the front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS, the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part.
requirements.quote: however, the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be fitted with a closed-circuit tell-tale.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.

requirements.text: Where there is a positive indication in the communication form under item 'Luminous intensity is variable' of Annex 1 to UN Regulations Nos. 19 or 149, any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment of the front fog beam shall be performed automatically.
requirements.quote: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically

requirements.text: Where there is a positive indication in the communication form under item 'Luminous intensity is variable' of Annex 1 to UN Regulations Nos. 19 or 149, any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment of the front fog beam shall be performed in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.
requirements.quote: and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.

requirements.text: Arrangement "A" shall apply to all motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Arrangement "A" shall apply to all motor vehicles.

requirements.text: Arrangement "B" shall apply to trailers only.
requirements.quote: Arrangement "B" shall apply to trailers only.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be more than 1,500 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp light shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
requirements.quote: The light shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.

requirements.text: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light.
requirements.quote: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light

requirements.text: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one and one-half seconds by the first extinction of the light.
requirements.quote: and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.

requirements.text: If a motor vehicle is equipped to draw a trailer, the control of the direction-indicator lamps on the drawing vehicle shall also operate the indicator lamps of the trailer.
requirements.quote: If a motor vehicle is equipped to draw a trailer, the control of the direction-indicator lamps on the drawing vehicle shall also operate the indicator lamps of the trailer.

requirements.text: In the event of failure, other than short-circuit, of one direction-indicator lamp, the other direction-indicator lamps shall continue to flash.
requirements.quote: In the event of failure, other than short-circuit, of one direction-indicator lamp, the others shall continue to flash

requirements.text: Where the vehicle is of category M1 or N1, the S1 or S2 stop lamp device that points on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: Where the vehicle is not of category M1 or N1, the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm.

requirements.text: Where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm, the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices may be reduced to 400 mm.
requirements.quote: This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 category stop lamp devices, the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.

requirements.text: Where one S3 or S4 category stop lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be mandatory on all motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on all motor vehicles.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be mandatory on trailers over 1,600 mm wide.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on trailers over 1,600 mm wide.

requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be two in number, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The front position lamp's apparent surface point farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane in the direction of the reference axis shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In the case of a trailer, the front position lamp's apparent surface point farthest from the median longitudinal plane in the direction of the reference axis shall not be more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In the case of a trailer, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For all categories of vehicles other than M1 and N1, the distance between the inner edges of the two front position lamp apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: Not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be not more than 1,500 mm above the ground, except that it shall be not more than 2,100 mm above the ground for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or for any other categories of vehicles where the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm.
requirements.quote: nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).

requirements.text: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements of paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.
requirements.quote: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° inwards, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane, and in the case of trailers the angle inwards may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane. In the case of trailers, the angle inwards may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 80° outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above the horizontal.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above the horizontal.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2 to be considered visible.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2.

requirements.text: Where, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be oriented forwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Forwards.

requirements.text: The front position lamp electrical connection shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11, except that where a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: In accordance with paragraph 5.11. However, if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: The front position lamp closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.

requirements.text: The front position lamp closed-circuit tell-tale shall be non-flashing.
requirements.quote: This tell-tale shall be non-flashing

requirements.text: The front position lamp closed-circuit tell-tale shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps.

requirements.text: The front position lamp closed-circuit tell-tale requirement shall not apply while the daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: This requirement does not apply while the daytime running lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: The front position lamp failure tell-tale shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.quote: a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: Where one or more infrared radiation generator(s) is (are) installed inside the front position lamp, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be allowed to be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.
